_comment: ASSEMBLIES ONLY, NOT INGOTS, and that is the scoping decision worth recording. An alloy ingot is
a MIXTURE - you remelt it, you do not prise it apart with a knife - so conductive, energetic,
dark steel and the rest are deliberately absent from this set. What is here is the things a
player manufactures, supersedes, and ends up with a chest of.
THE MARGIN. A basic capacitor costs two Grains of Infinity, one copper ingot and four gold
nuggets. This returns half a grain on average, one gold nugget at 40 percent, and scrap - so
the grains lose four to one and the gold ten to one.
TEMPORARY, and guarded. Pack content living in the engine because the pack cannot ship data on
26.1.2; it leaves with the rest - see docs/handoff_cross_mod_teardown.md.
The neoforge:mod_loaded guard is load-bearing rather than tidy. Strip it and this file does not
merely fail to apply, it fails to PARSE on its own ids, which is one ERROR line in an otherwise

GATED MATERIALS REMOVED. This first returned minecraft:gold_nugget, and GemTierTests.no_teardown_recipe_yields_a_gated_material rejected it: everything past the iron gate - diamond, emerald, redstone, gold, amethyst - has the Separator as its sanctioned route and teardown is not it. Gold is past the iron gate, so it is this mod's own scrap instead, which only widens the margin below.
